in_hebrew.name: Titus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Titus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Titus means 'honoring' or 'grace'. In the New Testament, Titus was a Greek Christian and a companion of Paul. He was later entrusted with the task of organizing and overseeing the Christian communities in Crete.

in_latin.name: Titus
in_latin.meaning: Titus, Latin form of Greek name, meaning 'honour, reputation'
in_latin.long_meaning: Titus, Latin form of Greek name Τίτος, meaning 'honour, reputation' or 'glory', derived from Greek word τιμή (timē), signifying esteem, respect, and dignity, originally used as a surname to indicate social status, in early Christian tradition Titus was a prominent figure, a companion of Paul, and a leader in the early Christian church, later revered as a saint, and his name has become a symbol of noble character and Christian leadership
